title: MIMAH'S ATELIER – Business & Website Discovery Questionnaire
description: Definition of every section and question. Used to drive the digital questionnaire and to interpret exported response files.
storageNote: Your answers are saved only on this device, in this browser. Nothing is sent to anyone until you press Submit (or send the file yourself).

answerTypes.file: string[] of file names (files are sent separately)

sections.title: About Mimah's Atelier
sections.description: Let's start with you and your story. There are no wrong answers. Write the way you would speak to a friend; we will shape it into polished website words later.

questions.label: What is the full name of your business?
questions.example: Mimah's Atelier

questions.label: How exactly should the name be written?
questions.help: Capital letters, apostrophe, spacing: tell us the version you consider correct.
questions.example: Mimah's Atelier (not MIMAHS ATELIER)

questions.label: Does the name have a meaning, or a story behind it?
questions.help: Who is Mimah? Why 'Atelier'? Customers love knowing this.

questions.label: In one sentence, how would you describe what your business does?
questions.example: I make handmade crochet bags and clothing for women who love unique pieces.

questions.label: How did the business start?
questions.help: The moment, the place, the first item you sold.

questions.label: When did it start?
questions.example: March 2021, or 'about 3 years ago'

questions.label: Who is the founder/owner? What name should appear on the website?
questions.example: Mimah (first name only) / Full name

questions.label: Do you make everything yourself?
questions.help: This helps us write honest, accurate copy such as 'handmade by me' or 'handmade by our team'.
options: I have helpers or a small team

questions.label: How did you start crocheting? Who taught you, and when did you fall in love with it?
What inspired you to turn crochet into a business?
What makes your business special or different from other crochet sellers?
What are you most proud of so far?
questions.example: A wedding order, my first 100 customers, a bag that went overseas...

questions.label: What does your business stand for?
Mission: what are you trying to do for your customers every day?
questions.help: No official wording needed. Say it in your own words.

questions.label: Vision: what do you hope Mimah's Atelier will become one day?
Which values describe your business? (choose up to 5)
options: Uniqueness: no two pieces the same

questions.label: How do you want customers to FEEL when they wear or use your work?
Short introduction (2–3 sentences) you'd be happy to see on the home page
questions.help: A quick 'hello' to a new visitor.

questions.label: Your longer 'About Us' story
questions.help: Tell it as a story: where you started, the challenges, what you love, where you're going. A few paragraphs is perfect. Bullet points are fine too.

sections.title: Brand Identity
sections.description: Here we learn how Mimah's Atelier should look and feel: colours, style and personality. Pictures say a lot, so share links to anything you love.

questions.label: Is your current logo the official Mimah's Atelier logo?
options: It is in use but I may change it
I am still working on it

questions.label: Do you have the original, high-quality logo file?
questions.help: This is the file the designer gave you, often ending in .png, .ai, .svg, .pdf or .eps. A WhatsApp-compressed picture is not the same thing.
options: Yes, I have the original file(s)
I only have it as a photo or screenshot
A designer made it and may have the file
Not sure what that means: we'll help

questions.label: Which versions of the logo exist?
Upload placeholder: logo files
questions.help: This prototype stores file names only. You'll send the actual files with the checklist at the end (WhatsApp, email or Drive).

questions.label: Which colours do you like for your brand?
Which colours are in your logo or already used on your pages?
questions.example: Purple and gold. If you know the colour codes, add them (like #7B5EA7).

questions.label: Are there colours you do NOT want?
questions.example: No bright orange, no neon

questions.label: Which words describe the visual style you like?
If you could only pick THREE, how should the brand feel?
Which styles do you dislike, or never want your brand to look like?
questions.example: Too childish, too corporate, too cluttered, too dark...

questions.label: Lettering and fonts: which feels most like you?
options: A mix of elegant and modern

questions.label: Do you know a font or lettering style you love, or the one in your logo?
questions.example: The Mimah's Atelier logo uses a script font

questions.label: Share links to websites, Instagram pages, brands or Pinterest boards whose look you love
questions.help: Paste links or @handles, one per line.
questions.example:
@somebrand
https://pinterest.com/...

questions.label: What exactly do you like about them?
questions.help: The colours? The photos? How simple it is? How cozy it feels?

questions.label: What 5 words do you want people to associate with Mimah's Atelier?
questions.example: Handmade, elegant, unique, warm, Zimbabwean

sections.title: Your Products
sections.description: This is the heart of the website. Tell us exactly what you sell today. Please tick only what you really offer. Don't worry about perfect details, start with your most popular items and send the rest later.

questions.label: Which of these do you currently sell?
questions.help: Tick everything you currently offer. Leave out anything you don't.

questions.label: Anything else you make that isn't in the list? Anything you plan to add soon?
Which items sell best, or get the most compliments?
questions.help: These will probably be featured on the home page.

questions.label: Do you have a 'signature' piece you're known for?
Your product list: add one card per product (or per kind of product)
questions.help: Add at least your 3–5 best sellers now. If you already have a price list or catalogue, skip this and upload it at the end instead (Section 23). 'Not sure' answers are fine: just leave a field blank.

fields.label: Is the price fixed or does it vary?
Sizes
fields.ex: S, M, L or custom measurements

fields.label: Do you have photos of it?

questions.label: Upload placeholder: price list or product catalogue
questions.help: A photo of your list, a spreadsheet, a PDF, anything works. Send the actual file with your assets.

questions.label: How are your prices decided?
options: Changes with how complex the design is

questions.label: Anything we should know about how your prices work?
questions.example: Larger sizes cost extra; textured stitches cost more.

questions.label: Which materials do you mainly work with?
Is your work mostly…
For clothing: what sizes do you make?
questions.example: XS–XL; I also make to measure

questions.label: When a product is sold out, what should the website do?
options: Show 'Sold out' and keep it visible
Show 'Sold out: order a similar one'

questions.label: How often do you add new designs?
Are there busy seasons or seasonal collections?
questions.example: December gifts, Mother's Day, winter

questions.label: How do you keep track of what you have in stock right now?
options: I make to order, so there is no stock

questions.label: Is there anything you do NOT want shown on the website?
questions.example: Old designs, discounted items

sections.title: Custom Orders
sections.description: Custom orders may be a big part of your business. Help us understand exactly how they work today and how you'd love them to work.

questions.label: Do you accept custom crochet orders?
options: Yes, but only some types or at some times

questions.label: What kinds of custom orders do you accept?
options: Recreating a picture the customer brings

any: Yes, but only some types or at some times

questions.label: How does a customer place a custom order today?
questions.example: They WhatsApp me a picture, I reply with a price, we agree...

questions.label: What information do you need from a customer before you can quote?
Do customers need to send reference pictures?
Can customers choose colours?
Can customers choose sizes?
Can customers request completely original designs?
options: Only variations of my existing designs

questions.label: How do you work out the price of a custom order?
options: Fixed prices for each item type

questions.label: Should customers see a price (or price range) before they send a request?
options: No, I quote after seeing the details
Both: 'from' prices, then a final quote

questions.label: Do you ask for a deposit on custom orders?
What deposit percentage?
When is the remaining balance paid?
options: When it is finished, before delivery

questions.label: How long does a custom order usually take?
questions.example: 1–2 weeks for bags, 3 weeks for dresses

questions.label: How many custom orders can you handle at the same time?
What happens if a customer changes their mind after you've started?
What happens if a customer cancels? (Deposit refundable? Within what time?)
What happens if you can't complete an order?
questions.example: Illness, yarn unavailable...

questions.label: Do you offer rush orders?
Are rush orders charged extra? How much?
questions.example: Yes, 25% extra

questions.label: Is there a minimum order value or quantity?
questions.example: No minimum / USD 20 minimum

questions.label: Would you like to share progress photos with the customer while you work?
Does the customer approve a sketch/photo/colour plan before you begin?
Describe your IDEAL custom-order process, step by step
questions.help: Imagine everything running smoothly. What happens at each step? A sentence or two is enough.

questions.label: Tell us about a recent custom order you were proud of (optional)
questions.help: It helps us understand the real thing.

sections.title: Pricing & Payments
sections.description: How you charge and get paid. We won't assume anything; tick only what you really use or want to use.

questions.label: Which currencies do you use for pricing?
Should the website show prices publicly?
options: A mix, depending on the product

questions.label: Do your prices include delivery?
How often do your prices change?
Which payment methods do you accept, or want to accept?
Anything we should know about how payment works?
questions.help: Please do NOT type account or wallet numbers here. We'll collect them securely later.
questions.example: Customers send EcoCash then WhatsApp me the confirmation.

questions.label: Should customers be able to pay on the website itself?
Do you issue receipts or invoices?
Do you offer discounts?
Which promotions do you run, or might you run?
options: Free delivery over a certain amount

questions.label: Do you offer wholesale pricing?
options: Not yet, but I'd like to

questions.label: Wholesale details: minimum quantity, discount, who it's for

any: Not yet, but I'd like to

questions.label: Do you sell bundles or sets?
Gift cards or vouchers?

sections.title: Customers & Target Market
sections.description: Who buys from you, and why? Think of real customers you've met.

questions.label: Who are your main customers?
What age groups buy from you most?
Where are your customers?
Roughly, what is your customers' budget like?
What kind of fashion or style do they love?
questions.example: Boho, church wear, beach wear, trendy streetwear...

questions.label: How do they usually shop? When do they buy most?
questions.example: They find me on Instagram, message on WhatsApp, buy at month-end or around holidays.

questions.label: Why do customers buy crochet from you?
What do customers ask you for most often?
What questions do customers ask again and again?
questions.help: This becomes the FAQ section and saves you time on WhatsApp.
questions.example: How long does it take? Can you do it in another colour? Do you deliver to Harare?

questions.label: What do your customers value most?
Why do they choose Mimah's Atelier over other options?
questions.help: Including cheaper shop-bought items, or other crochet sellers.

questions.label: Would you like to attract customers outside Zimbabwe?

sections.title: Ordering & Customer Communication
sections.description: How do customers reach you today, and how would you like it to work on the website?

questions.label: How do customers contact you today?
Which way do you PREFER customers to contact you?
Which WhatsApp number should customers use?
questions.help: This will be shown publicly on the website. If you'd rather use a separate business number, tell us in the notes at the end.
questions.example: +263 7X XXX XXXX

questions.label: Is this a WhatsApp Business account or regular WhatsApp?
Phone number for calls (if different)
Email address customers should use

questions.label: Which contact details may be shown publicly?

options: Not sure what that means: explain it

questions.label: Should customers be able to send you an enquiry through a form on the website?
Where should form enquiries be sent?
questions.help: Enquiries sent straight to WhatsApp may need a paid service. We'll advise.
options: Saved in a dashboard I can check

questions.label: Do you want customers to get an automatic 'thank you, we got your message' reply?
Do you want customers to receive order updates (e.g. 'Your bag is ready')?
How do you usually talk to customers? Paste a typical friendly reply you send.

Do you deliver?

Details on delivery fees

sections.title: Website Goals
sections.description: What should the website do for you?

questions.label: What should the website achieve for you?
Rank your TOP 5 goals, with 1 being most important
questions.help: Choose one goal for each position.

questions.label: What would make you say the website was a success after 6 months?

What worries you about having a website?

sections.title: Policies
sections.description: Please tell us your REAL rules, not what you think a business 'should' say. We won't invent policies for you; we'll only write down what you decide. Custom-order cancellations are in Section 4.

questions.label: Do you accept returns on ready-made items?

The customer receives the wrong item or colour: what then?

If an order will be late: what happens, and how are customers told?
Unclaimed orders: how long do you keep them, and then what?
Product care: how should customers wash and care for crochet items?
questions.example: Hand wash cold, dry flat, don't hang.

questions.label: What are customers responsible for?
questions.example: Giving correct measurements, answering messages promptly, collecting on time.

questions.label: Would you like us to draft these policies in plain language from your answers, for you to approve?
